items.title: Narvin Kimball Interview, 1961-11-25
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] You said, David, remember, did it David Jones that played mellophone? David Jones played out there. [INTERVIEWEE] He played out there also.

ctx.x: I knew Baby Dodds, that's right. Baby Dodds, he was in the band. I remember, I remember seeing that picture. Um, they had a violinist on that boat too. He was in the band. He played violin and mellophone. I can't think of his name.
You said, David, remember, did it David Jones that played mellophone? David Jones played out there.
